safe_takeaways: The refreshed environment should keep using exact receipts rather than relying on memory-only state.
Goal prompt preservation and usage surfaces are relevant to long GHC phase continuity.
Deletion and import features must remain outside live use unless separately approved because they can mutate local state.
Unified mentions are useful for skills/plugins discovery, but skill files and plugin cache remain out of mutation scope unless exact approval exists.
Credential-storage changes are a safety boundary, not a reason to publish secrets or raw account data.
phase_application: Keep v545 Browser/Lumen route checks status-only.
Prefer omega-mini current-state receipts for sibling catch-up.
Use D drive for heavy artifacts and keep C drive monitored.
Carry source claims as cited planning context only, not proof of GMUT/THOS claims.
